verdict.rationale: Netlify's first-party docs say it offers built-in "simple password protection for a personal portfolio site". That is a platform-provided way to gate a deployed site without building a custom auth system, so it covers the story's core. Missing for 10: details on how password protection is configured (dashboard, CLI or config), plan or tier availability and any limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system

citations.quote: simple password protection for a personal portfolio site
